Text:
Sentinel.
Response: After Aragorn commits to a quest, spend 1 resource from his resource pool to ready him.
Front.FlavorText:
`I am Aragorn son of Arathorn; and if by life or death I can save you, I will.`
-The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Response: After Théodred commits to a quest, choose a hero committed to that quest. Add 1 resource to that hero`s resource pool.
Front.FlavorText:
`Not all is dark. Take courage, Lord of the Mark...`
-Gandalf, The Two Towers

Text: Response: After Glóin suffers damage, add 1 resource to his resource pool for each point of damage he just suffered.
Front.FlavorText:
His beard, very long and forked, was white, nearly as white as the snow-white cloth of his garments.
-The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Gimli gets +1 Attack for each damage token on him.
Front.FlavorText:
`Men need many words before deeds. My axe is restless in my hands`
-The Two Towers

Text:
Ranged.
Response: After Legolas participates in an attack that destroys an enemy, place 2 progress tokens on the current quest.
Front.FlavorText:
`I can walk this path, but others have not this skill.`
-The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: While Thalin is committed to a quest, deal 1 damage to each enemy as it is revealed by the encounter deck.
Action: Discard 1 card from your hand to give Éowyn +1 Willpower until the end of the phase. This effect may be triggered by each player once each round.
Front.FlavorText:
Slender and tall she was in her white robe girt with silver; but strong she seemed and stern as steel, a daughter of kings.
-The Two Towers

Text: Response: Exhaust Eleanor to cancel the `when revealed` effects of a treachery card just revealed by the encounter deck. Then, discard that card, and replace it with the next card from the encounter deck.
Front.FlavorText:
`Gondor wanes, you say. But Gondor stands, and even the end of its strength is very strong.`
-Boromir, The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Dúnhere can target enemies in the staging area when he attacks alone. When doing so, he gets +1 Attack.
Front.FlavorText:
Captains rode to meet him at the ford, bearing messages from Gandalf. Dúnhere, chieftain of the folk of Harrowdale, was at their head.
-The Return of the King

Text: Action: Exhaust Denethor to look at the top card of the encounter deck. You may move that card to the bottom of the deck.
Front.FlavorText:
`And the lord Denethor is unlike other men: he sees far.`
-Beregond, The Return of the King

Text: Action: Pay 1 resource from Glorfindel`s pool to heal 1 damage on any character. (Limit once per round.)
Front.FlavorText:
`You saw him for a moment as he is upon the other side: one of the mighty of the firstborn.`
-Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Action: Exhaust Beravor to choose a player. That player draws 2 cards. Limit once per round.
Front.FlavorText:
But in the wild lands beyond Bree there were mysterious wanderers. The Bree-folk called them Rangers, and knew nothing of their origin.
-The Fellowship of the Ring

`But the Lords of Minas Tirith still fight on, defying our enemies, keeping the passage of the River from Argonath to the Sea.`
-Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Action: Exhaust Faramir to choose a player. Each character controlled by that player gets +1 Willpower until the end of the phase.
Front.FlavorText:
`He leads now in all perilous ventures. But his life is charmed, or fate spares him for some other end.`
-Mablung, Ranger of Ithilien,
The Two Towers

Text: Response: After Son of Arnor enters play, choose an enemy card in the staging area or currently engaged with another player. Engage that enemy.
Front.FlavorText:
...and the North-realm they made in Arnor, and the South-realm in Gondor above the mouths of Anduin.
-The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Response: After Snowbourn Scout enters play, choose a location. Place 1 progress token on that location.
Front.FlavorText:
...he saw not a shadow, nor a blur, but the small figures of horsemen, many horsemen, and the glint of morning on the tips of their spears was like the twinkle of minute stars beyond the edge of mortal sight.
-The Two Towers

Text: Ranged.
Front.FlavorText:
`We have been keeping watch on the rivers, ever since we saw a great troop of Orcs going north towards Moria, along the skirts of the mountains, many days ago.`
-Haldir of Lórien, The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Response: After Longbeard Orc Slayer enters play, deal 1 damage to each Orc enemy in play.
Front.FlavorText:
Five dead Orcs lay there. They had been hewn with many cruel strokes, and two had been beheaded. The ground was wet with their dark blood.
-The Two Towers

Text: Response: After a Dwarf hero you control leaves play, put Brok Ironfist into play from your hand.
Front.FlavorText:
...there is no knowing what a Dwarf will not dare and do for revenge and the recovery of his own.
-The Hobbit

Text: Action: Choose and ready 1 ally card.
Front.FlavorText:
`...no road looks toward safety any longer. Be vigilant!`
-Gandalf, The Return of the King

Text: Action: Exhaust 1 hero you control to choose and ready a different hero.
Front.FlavorText:
`We will make such a chase as shall be accounted a marvel among the Three Kindreds: Elves, Dwarves, and Men.`
-Aragorn, The Two Towers

Text: Action: Until the end of the phase, all characters get +1 Attack. All Gondor characters also get +1 Defense until the end of the phase.
Front.FlavorText:
And the tree that was withered shall be renewed,
and he shall plant it in high places,

and the City shall be blessed.
-The Return of the King

Text: Action: Put 1 ally card into play from your hand. At the end of the phase, if that ally is still in play, return it to your hand.
Front.FlavorText:
There is a seed of courage hidden (often deeply, it is true) in the heart of the fattest and most timid hobbit, waiting for some final and desperate danger to make it grow.
-The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Response: After an ally card leaves play, that card`s controller draws 2 cards.
Front.FlavorText:
`He fell defending the Hobbits, while I was away upon the hill.`
-Aragorn, The Two Towers

Text: Action: Ready all character cards in play.
Front.FlavorText:
`If there is only one way, then I must take it. What comes after must come.`
-Frodo Baggins, The Two Towers

Text:
Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains the Gondor trait.
Action: Exhaust Steward of Gondor to add 2 resources to attached hero`s resource pool.
Front.FlavorText: `It was commanded yesterday.` -Denethor, The Return of the King

Text:
Attach to a hero. Restricted.
Attached hero gains +2 Willpower.
If attached hero is Aragorn, he also gains a Spirit resource icon.
Front.FlavorText:
`You needn`t,` said Bilbo. `As a matter of fact it was all mine. Except that Aragorn insisted on my putting in a green stone. He seemed to think it important. I don`t know why.`
-The Fellowship of the Ring
`I am glad to have you standing nigh with your stout legs and your hard axe.` -Legolas, The Two Towers

Text:
Sentinel.
Response: After Gondorian Spearman is declared as a defender, deal 1 damage to the attacking enemy.
Front.FlavorText: More than a thousand were there mustered. Their spears were like a springing wood. -The Two Towers

Text: Ranged.
Front.FlavorText: A few of the riders appeared to be bowmen, skilled at shooting from a running horse. -The Two Towers

Text: Action: Beorn gains +5 Attack until the end of the phase. At the end of the phase in which you trigger this effect, shuffle Beorn back into your deck. (Limit once per round.)
Front.FlavorText: `I don`t need your service, thank you...but I expect you need mine.` -The Hobbit

Text: Action: Choose a character. Until the end of the phase, that character gains +1 Attack and +1 Defense.
Front.FlavorText: Throwing back his cloak, he laid his hand on the hilt of a sword that had hung concealed by his side. They did not dare to move. -The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Action: Exhaust a character you control with the ranged keyword to choose a player. Deal 1 damage to each enemy engaged with that player.
Front.FlavorText: Arrows thick as the rain came whistling over the battlements, and fell clinking and glancing on the stones. Many found their mark. -The Two Towers

Text: Combat Action: Choose an enemy engaged with a player. That enemy cannot attack that player this phase.
Front.FlavorText: A few brave men were strung before them to make a feint of resistance, and many there fell before the rest drew back and fled to either side. -The Hobbit

Text: Action: Exhaust a character you control to immediately declare it as an attacker (and resolve its attack) against any eligible enemy target.
Front.FlavorText: `...for he that strikes the first blow, if he strikes it hard enough, may need to strike no more.` -Gandalf, The Two Towers

Text:
You must use resources from 3 different heroes` pools to pay for this card.
Action: Choose a player. That player`s engaged enemies cannot attack that player this phase.
Front.FlavorText:
Without a word or cry, suddenly, the Riders halted. A thicket of spears were pointed towards the strangers...
-The Two Towers

Text: Response: After a character is declared as a defender, deal 2 damage to the attacking enemy.
Front.FlavorText:
A swift stroke she dealt, skilled and deadly.
-The Return of the King

Text: Action: Choose a player. That player may declare any number of his eligible characters as defenders against each enemy attacking him this phase.
Front.FlavorText: ...and when the task was done, there they would come to an end, alone, houseless, foodless in the midst of a terrible desert. There could be no return. -The Return of the King

Text:
Attach to a hero. Restricted.
Attached hero gets +1 Attack when attacking an Orc.
Response: After attached hero attacks and destroys an enemy, place 1 progress token on the current quest.
Front.FlavorText:
It was rather splendid to be wearing a blade made in Gondolin for the goblin-wars of which so many songs had sung...
-The Hobbit

Text:
Attach to a hero. Restricted.
Attached hero gets +4 Hit Points.
Front.FlavorText:
`Go to the armouries of the Citadel, and get you there the livery and gear of the Tower.`
-Denethor, The Return of the King

Text:
Attach to a hero. Restricted.
Attached hero gains +1 Attack. (+2 Attack instead if attached hero is a Dwarf.)
Front.FlavorText:
`But keep your bow ready to hand, and I will keep my axe loose in my belt.`
-Gimli, The Two Towers

Text:
Attach to a hero. Restricted.
Response: After a character is destroyed, add 1 resource to attached hero`s pool.
Front.FlavorText:
`Slow should you be to wind that horn again, Boromir,` said Elrond, `until you stand once more on the borders of your land, and dire need is on you.`
-The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Action: Reduce your threat by 3 to give control of Wandering Took to another player. Raise that player`s threat by 3. (Limit once per round.)
Front.FlavorText: ...but certainly there was something not entirely hobbit-like about them, and once in a while members of the Took-clan would go and have adventures. -The Hobbit

Text: Response: After Lórien Guide commits to a quest, place 1 progress token on the active location.
Front.FlavorText: `Indeed deep in the wood they dwell...` -Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Response: After Northern Tracker commits to a quest, place 1 progress token on each location in the staging area.
Front.FlavorText: `What roads would any dare to tread, what safety would there be in quiet lands, or in the homes of simple men at night, if the Dúnedain were asleep, or were all gone into the grave?` -Aragorn, The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Action: Reduce one player`s threat by 6, or reduce each player`s threat by 2.

Text: Response: After you travel to a location, exhaust a Spirit character to place 2 progress tokens on that location.

Text: Response: Cancel a shadow effect just triggered during combat.
Front.FlavorText: `The hasty stroke goes oft astray,` said Aragorn. `We must press our Enemy, and no longer wait on him for the next move.` -The Return of the King

Text: Action: Choose a player. Shuffle that player`s discard pile back into his deck. Remove Will of the West from the game.
Front.FlavorText: `If Gondor has such men still in these days of fading, great must have been its glory in the days of its rising.` -Legolas, The Return of the King

Text: Response: Cancel the `when revealed` effects of a card that was just revealed from the encounter deck.
Front.FlavorText:
`There is naught that you can do, other than to resist, with hope or without it`
-Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Action: Choose an enemy engaged with a player. Return that enemy to the staging area.
Front.FlavorText:
The light of the torches and the fire flickered about them...
-The Hobbit

Text: Action: Return 1 Spirit card from your discard pile to your hand.
Front.FlavorText:
The dwarves no more shall suffer wrong,
The dwarves of yore made mighty spells,
While hammers fell like ringing bells
In places deep, where dark things sleep,
In hollow halls beneath the fells.
-The Hobbit

Text: Action: Choose a hero in any player`s discard pile. Put that card into play, under its owner`s control.
Front.FlavorText:
`Yes, fortune or fate have helped you,` said Gandalf, `not to mention courage.`
-The Fellowship of the Ring

Text:
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains +1 Willpower.
Front.FlavorText:
`You are indeed high in the favor of the Lady!`
-Unnamed Elf of Lórien,
The Fellowship of the Ring

Text:
Attach to a hero.

Front.FlavorText:

you are fat and lazy.
You cannot trap me, though you try,
in your cobwebs crazy.`
-Bilbo Baggins, The Hobbit

Text: Response: After you play Erebor Hammersmith, return the topmost attachment in any player`s discard pile to his hand.
Front.FlavorText: `In Erebor in the Kingdom of Dain there is such skill...` -Aragorn, The Return of the King

Text: Action: Exhaust Henamarth Riversong to look at the top card of the encounter deck.
Front.FlavorText:
`And I reckon there`s Elves and Elves. They`re all elvish enough, but they`re not all the same.`
-Sam Gamgee,
The Fellowship of the Ring

...while the four dwarves sat around the table, and talked about mines and gold and troubles with goblins...
-The Hobbit

-The Return of the King

-Elrond, The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Action: Choose a player. That player draws 3 cards.

`That is the fairest of all the dwellings of my people. There are no trees like the tress of that land.`
-Legolas, The Fellowship of the Ring

-Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Action: Choose a player. Heal all damage on each hero controlled by that player.

`...and my house is open to you, if ever you come back this way again.`
-Beorn, The Hobbit

`We shall have it like a coney in a trap. Then we shall learn what kind of thing it is.`
-Unidentified Man of Gondor,
The Two Towers

Text:
Attach to a hero.

-The Fellowship of the Ring

`Too much; too many dark things,` said Strider grimly.
-The Fellowship of the Ring

Text:
Attach to a character.

...how much more of this would they have to endure, or could they endure?
-The Two Towers

In many-pillared halls of stone
With golden roof and silver floor,
And runes of power upon the door.
-The Fellowship of the Ring

Action: Reveal 1 less card from the encounter deck this phase. (To a minimum of 1.)
Front.FlavorText:
`The wide world is all about you: you can fence yourselves in, but you cannot for ever fence it out.`
-Gildor, The Fellowship of the Ring

Text:
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains a Spirit resource icon.
Front.FlavorText:
The Road goes ever on and on
Down from the door where it began.
Now far ahead the road has gone,
And I must follow, if I can.
-The Fellowship of the Ring

Text:
Action: Raise your threat by 1 to ready Boromir. (Limit once per phase.)
Action: Discard Boromir to deal 2 damage to each enemy engaged with a single player.
Front.FlavorText: `...in Gondor we must trust to such weapons as we have.` -The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Response: Discard Dunedain Watcher from play to cancel the shadow effects of a card just triggered.
Front.FlavorText: `If simple folk are free from care and fear, simple they will be, and we must be secret to keep them so. That has been the task of my kindred, while the years have lengthened and the grass has grown.` -Strider, The Fellowship of the Ring

Text:
Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains ranged.
Action: Pay 1 resource from attached hero`s pool to attach Dunedain Cache to another hero.

Ranged. Vassal of the Windlord cannot have restricted attachments.
Forced: After an attack in which Vassal of the Windlord attacked resolves, discard Vassal of the Windlord from play.

Attach to a hero.
Action: Exhaust Song of Mocking to choose another hero. Until the end of the phase, attached hero takes all damage assigned to the chosen hero.
Front.FlavorText:
Old fat spider spinning in a tree!
Old fat spider can`t see me!
Attercop! Attercop!
Won`t you stop. Stop your spinning and look for me! 
-Bilbo Baggins, The Hobbit

Text: While Elfhelm is ready, he gains: `Response: After your threat is raised as the result of questing unsuccessfully, or by an encounter or quest card effect, reduce your threat by 1.`
Front.FlavorText: `But my lord sends word that we must set ourselves in readiness: orders may come for a sudden move.` -The Return of the King

Text: Action: Until the end of the phase, Rohan characters do not exhaust to commit to quests.
Front.FlavorText: `But we must ride more warily; for war is abroad, and the Rohirrim, the Horse-lords, do not sleep, even if it seems so from afar.` -Gandalf, The Two Towers

Text: Response: After a Silvan character readies during the refresh phase, heal 1 damage from that character.
Front.FlavorText: `The Wood-elves tracked him first, an easy task for them, for his trail was still fresh then.` -Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Rings

Text:
Attach to a Hobbit character.
Action: Exhaust Fast Hitch to ready attached character.
Front.FlavorText: `And I put as fast a hitch over the stump as any one could have done, in the Shire or out of it.` -Sam, The Two Towers

Text:
Attach to a hero.
Attached hero gains a Tactics resource icon.
Front.FlavorText: We go, we go, we go to war, to hew the stone and break the door. -The Two Towers

Text: While Dáin Ironfoot is ready, Dwarf characters get +1 Attack and +1 Willpower.
Front.FlavorText: `You have not heard of Dáin and the dwarves of the Iron Hills?` -Bilbo Baggins, The Hobbit

Text:
Attach to a hero. Attached hero gains sentinel.
Action: Pay 1 resource from attached hero`s pool to attach Dunedain Signal to another hero.

Play after shadow cards have been dealt, before any attacks have resolved.
Combat Action: Each player may choose and discard 1 facedown shadow card from an enemy with which he is engaged.
Front.FlavorText: `Dawn take you all, and be stone to you!` -Gandalf, The Hobbit

Text:
Eagles of the Misty Mountains cannot have restricted attachments. Eagles of the Misty Mountains gets +1 Attack and +1 Defense for each facedown attachment it has.
Response: After another Eagle character leaves play, you may attach that card facedown to Eagles of the Misty Mountains.

Attach to a Tactics hero.
Action: Exhaust Support of the Eagles to choose an Eagle ally. Until the end of the phase, attached hero adds that ally`s Attack or Defense (choose 1) to its own.
Front.FlavorText: `I would bear you, whither you will, even were you made of stone.` -Gwaihir, The Return of the King

Text: Response: After you play West Road Traveller from your hand, switch the active location with any other location in the staging area.
Front.FlavorText: The dark world was rushing by, and the wind sang loudly in his ears. -The Return of the King

Text: Action: Until the end of the phase, all Rohan characters get +2 Willpower.
Front.FlavorText: With astonishing speed and skill they checked their steeds, wheeled, and came charging round. -The Two Towers

Text: While Mirkwood Runner is attacking alone, the defending enemy does not count its Defense.
Front.FlavorText: `...let a ploughman plough, but choose an otter for swimming, and for running light over grass and leaf or over snow-an Elf.` -Legolas, The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Action: Look at the top card of the encounter deck. Then, you may pay 1 Lore resource to return Rumour from the Earth to your hand.
Front.FlavorText: `Where sight fails the earth may bring us rumour,` said Aragorn. `The land must groan under their hated feet.` -The Two Towers

Text: Action: Move the top card of the encounter discard pile to the top of the encounter deck.
Front.FlavorText: The wizard`s face remained grave and attentive, and only a flicker in his deep eyes showed that he was startled and indeed alarmed. `It has been called that before,` he said, `but not by you.` -The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Response: After Dwalin attacks and destroys an Orc enemy, lower your threat by 2.
Action: Pay 1 resource from a hero`s resource pool to add 1 resource to Bifur`s resource pool. Any player may trigger this ability. (Limit once per round.)
Front.FlavorText: `And winter comes after autumn.` - Bifur, The Hobbit

Text:
Attach to a Dwarf hero.
Action: Exhaust Narvi`s Belt to give attached hero a Leadership, Lore, Tactics, or Spirit icon until the end of the phase.
Action: Choose a Dwarf hero. That hero gets +2 Willpower, +2 Attack, and +2 Defense until the end of the round.
Front.FlavorText:
A king he was on carven throne
In many-pillared halls of stone
With golden roof and silver floor,
And runes of power upon the door.
-The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Response: After players quest unsuccessfully, choose a player. That player does not raise his threat.
Veteran of Nanduhirion enters play with 1 damage on it.
Front.FlavorText: With cries of `Moria!` and `Dain, Dain!` the dwarves of the Iron Hills plunged in... -The Hobbit

Text:
Attach to a Dwarf character. Restricted.
Attached character gets +1 Attack.
Response: After attached character attacks, deal 1 damage to the defending enemy.
Front.FlavorText: `We make good armour and keen swords, but we cannot again make mail or blade to match those that were made before the dragon came.` -Glóin, The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Action: Choose a Dwarf character. Until the end of the phase, that character gets +3 Attack.
Front.FlavorText:
Down from the wall leapt Gimli with a fierce cry the echoed in the cliffs. `Khazâd! Khazâd!` He soon had work enough.
-The Two Towers

Text: Action: Exhaust Zigil Miner and name a number to discard the top 2 cards of your deck. If at least one of those cards has cost equal to the named number, choose a hero you control. For each card that matches the named number, add 1 resource to that hero`s resource pool.
Action: Each Dwarf character gets +1 Willpower until the end of the phase. (+2 Willpower instead if the active location is an Underground or Dark location.)

Erebor Record Keeper cannot attack or defend.
Action: Exhaust Erebor Record Keeper and pay 1 Lore resource to choose and ready a Dwarf character.
Action: Exhaust a Dwarf character to place 2 progress tokens on the active location. (4 progress tokens instead if it is an Underground or Mountain location.)
Front.FlavorText:
`There is a land where our fathers worked of old...`
Gimli, The Fellowship of the Ring

Text:
Attach to a Dwarf or Hobbit character. Limit 1 Boots from Erebor per character.

Secrecy 3.

Front.FlavorText: `Get up lazy-bones...` -The Hobbit

Text: Response: After another player plays an attachment on a hero you control, you may (choose 1): ready 1 of that player`s heroes, have that player draw 1 card, or lower that player`s threat by 2.
Action: Exhaust Ravenhill Scout to move up to 2 progress tokens from 1 location to another location.
Front.FlavorText: `They made their first camp on the western side of the great southern spur, which ended in a height called Ravenhill.` -The Hobbit

Secrecy 2.

`I am older than I look, I might prove useful.`
-The Fellowship of the Ring

Sentinel.

Front.FlavorText:
`...in whom it was said that the likeness of Lúthien had come on earth again...she was the Evenstar of her people.`
-The Fellowship of the Ring

Attach to a Dwarf hero.

Secrecy 3.
Attach to a hero you control.
Attached hero collects 1 additional resource during the resource phase each round.
Response: After Háma is declared as an attacker, return a Tactics event from your discard pile to your hand. Then, choose and discard 1 card from your hand. (Limit 3 times per game for the group.)
Front.FlavorText:
`Yet in doubt a man of worth will trust to his own wisdom.`
-The Two Towers

Text: Action: Choose and discard 1 card from your hand to draw 1 card. (Limit once per round.)
Front.FlavorText:
Beside Glorfindel there were several other counsellors of Elrond`s household, of whom Erestor was the chief...
-The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Response: After an enemy is added to the staging area, deal 1 damage to that enemy. Players ignore that enemy while making engagement checks this round.

Attach to a Dwarf or Hobbit character. Restricted.
Attached character gets +1 hit point and +1 Defense.
Front.FlavorText:
`And all the arrows of all the hunters in the world would be in vain...
-Gimli, The Fellowship of the Ring

Text:
Secrecy 3.
Action: Enemies engaged with you cannot attack you this phase.

Attach to a Dwarf character.
Response: After you travel to a Mountain or Underground location, ready attached character and reduce your threat by 1.
Front.FlavorText: `This is more to my liking,` said the dwarf, stomping on the stones. `Ever my heart rises as we draw near the mountains.` -The Two Towers

Text: Action: Exhaust Warden of Healing to heal 1 damage on up to 2 different characters. Then, you may pay 2 Lore resources to ready Warden of Healing.
Front.FlavorText: `But for long years we healers have only sought to patch the rents made by the men of swords.` -Return of the King

Text: Action: Exhaust an Istari character to search your deck for 1 card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.
Front.FlavorText: `Picking up a faggot he held it aloft for a moment, and then with a word of command, naur an edraith ammen! he thrust the end of his staff into the midst of it. At once a great spout of green and blue flame sprang out, and the wood flared and sputtered.` -The Fellowship of the Ring

Text:
Attach to a Lore hero. Limit 1 per hero.
Response: After a Song card is played, exhaust Love of Tales to add 1 resource to attached hero`s resource pool.
Front.FlavorText:
`I listened because I couldn`t help myself, if you know what I mean. Lor bless me, sir, but I do love tales of that sort.`
-Sam Gamgee, The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Forced: After Glorfindel exhausts to commit to a quest, raise your threat by 1.
Front.FlavorText:
Glorfindel was tall and straight; his hair was of shining gold, his face fair and young and fearless and full of joy; his eyes were bright and keen, and has voice like music; on his brow sat wisdom, and in his hand was strength.
-The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Response: After Longbeard Elder commits to a quest, look at the top card of the encounter deck. If that card is a location, place 1 progress token on the current quest. Otherwise, Longbeard Elder gets -1 Willpower until the end of the phase.

Limit 1 per deck. Attach to a location.
Heroes do not exhaust to attack, defend, or commit to a quest while attached location is the active location.
Front.FlavorText:
`However it may prove, one must tread the path that need chooses!`
-Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

Text:
Ranged.

Front.FlavorText: `Beside them Gimli stood with his stout legs apart, wielding his dwarf-axe.` -The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Action: Exhaust Imladris Stargazer to choose a player. That player looks at the top 5 cards of his deck and then returns them to the top of his deck in any order.

Attach to a Noldor or Silvan hero.
Attached hero does not exhaust to commit to a quest.
Front.FlavorText:
`... those who have dwelt in the Blessed Realm live at once in both worlds, and against both the Seen and Unseen they have great power.`
-Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Action: Draw 2 cards. Then, discard 1 card from your hand.
Front.FlavorText:
`These are Daeron`s Runes, such as were used of old in Moria...`
-Gandalf, The Fellowship of the Ring

Text:
Attach to a Lore hero.

`But you do not stand alone.`
-The Fellowship of the Ring

`You should see the stone-paved roads of many colours! And the halls and cavernous streets under the earth with arches carved like trees; and the terraces and towers upon the Mountain`s sides! Then you would see that we have not been idle.`
-Glóin, The Fellowship of the Ring

Text:
Sentinel.
Lower the cost to play Weapon and Armor attachments on Beregond by 2.

Front.FlavorText: `By our valour the wild fold of the East are still restrained, and the terror of Morgul kept at bay...` -The Fellowship of the Ring

Text: Action: Exhaust Errand-rider to move 1 resource from the resource pool of a hero you control to another hero`s resource pool.
Front.FlavorText: For the people of the City used horses very little and they were seldom seen in their streets, save only those ridden by the errand-riders of their lord. -The Return of the King

Text: Lower the cost to play Citadel Custodian by 1 for each Gondor ally in play.

`These are the Rohirrim, as we name them, masters of horses... and have ever proved true to us, aiding us at need, and guarding our northern marches and the Gap of Rohan.`
-Faramir, The Two Towers

Text: Action: Choose a Gondor hero. Add 1 resource to that hero`s resource pool.
Front.FlavorText: Kings made tombs more splendid than houses of the living, and counted old names in the rolls of their descent dearer than the names of sons. -The Two Towers
`And the Enemy must pay dearly for the crossing of the River.` -Denethor, The Return of the King

Text: Action: Ready a defending Gondor character. That character gets +1 Defense until the end of the phase.
Front.FlavorText: ...seven walls of stone so strong and old that it seemed to have been not builded by carven by giants out of the bones of the earth. -The Return of the King

Attach to a Gondor or Dúnedain hero.

Front.FlavorText: `Believe not that in the land of Gondor the blood of Numenor is spent, nor all its pride and dignity forgotten.` -Boromir, The Fellowship of the Ring

Front.FlavorText: From Lamedon, a few grim hillmen without a captain. -The Return of the King

Front.FlavorText:
We heard of the horns in the hills ringing,
the swords shining in the South-kingdom.

Front.FlavorText: From the Anfalas, the Langstrand far away, a long line of men of many sorts, hunters and herdsmen and men of little villages... -The Return of the King

Text: Action: Draw 1 card for each hero you control with a printed Lore resource icon.
Front.FlavorText: `Let none now reject the counsels of Gandalf, whose long labours against Sauron come at last to their test.` -Aragorn, The Return of the King

`...the Elves feared and distrusted the world outside...`

Attach to a Tactics hero. Limit 1 per hero.

Front.FlavorText: He slew many of them and the rest fled. -The Two Towers

Forced: After a character leaves play, discard Silvan Refugee from play.
Front.FlavorText: `The Elves have their own labours and their own sorrows...` -Gildor, The Fellowship of the Ring

Text:
Play only if each hero you control has the printed Spirit resource icon.

Front.FlavorText: `Courage will now be your best defense against the storm that is at hand...` -Gandalf, The Return of the King

Text:
Play only if each hero you control has a printed Lore resource icon.
Action: Until the end of the phase, enemies do not make engagement checks
